name: Baseline Northeast Monsoon
description: Typical late-October conditions: scattered evening convective rain, no organised system.

name: Chennai Urban Cloudburst
description: Short, extreme rainfall concentrated over the Chennai metro and its northern suburbs.

name: Cauvery Delta Depression
description: Slow-moving depression tracking inland across the delta districts with 36h of steady heavy rain.

name: Severe Cyclonic Storm Landfall
description: Landfall near the Cuddalore-Nagapattinam coast with a broad rain shield and damaging wind.

name: Western Ghats Orographic Spell
description: Persistent upslope rain over the Nilgiris and Coimbatore ghat sections; landslide-prone.
